title: Fix Admin Dashboard infinite loading after Internet Identity login

requirements.text: Fix the Admin Dashboard page so it no longer hangs indefinitely after a successful Internet Identity login. The page currently shows an infinite loading state instead of rendering the admin tabs. Investigate and resolve the race condition or timeout issue in the admin authentication check (useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout) that causes the page to never transition out of the loading state in production.

quotes: Es passiert einfach nichts, die Seite lädt ewig.
Ja, ich bin eingeloggt mit Internet Identity.

acceptanceCriteria: After a successful Internet Identity login, navigating to the Admin Dashboard no longer shows an infinite loading spinner.
If the user is an admin, the admin tabs (collections, NFT items) are rendered correctly.
If the admin check call to the backend fails or times out, a clear error message or retry option is shown instead of an infinite spinner.
The fix works in the production (deployed) environment, not just local development.

requirements.text: Ensure the backend actor used in the Admin Dashboard is created with the authenticated identity (not anonymous) when the user is logged in via Internet Identity. If the actor is being instantiated before the identity is fully available, add proper sequencing so the admin check only fires once an authenticated actor is ready.

quotes: Es passiert einfach nichts, die Seite lädt ewig.
Ja, ich bin eingeloggt mit Internet Identity.

acceptanceCriteria: The isCallerAdmin backend call is only triggered after both the Internet Identity login is complete and an authenticated actor instance is available.
No unauthenticated (anonymous) actor call is made for the admin check when the user is logged in.
The AdminDashboard does not enter an infinite loading state due to the actor not being ready.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts — treat them as read-only.
Do not change the backend Motoko actor logic or admin authorization rules.
Preserve all existing admin UI functionality (collection management, NFT management tabs).
nonGoals: Adding new admin features or changing the admin UI layout.
Changing the Internet Identity authentication flow.
Modifying backend access control or principal management.
